initial_cli_failure.phase: CLI argument parsing before DB preparation or inference
initial_cli_failure.fix: Pass --role only for worker actions; private env files keep command errors free of credentials

limits: Ten finite trials, not a sustained capacity guarantee.
New chronological100/50/10 protocol is distinct from the old recent/random protocol; do not attribute cross-protocol duration changes to hardware.
Profiles selected different recipes and gradient work. Whole-loop effective directions/time is measured; pure hardware speedup or Qwen causal accuracy advantage is not established.
Repeated deterministic validation on the same100 issues is not additional independent evidence.

Positive paired bootstrap development intervals are unadjusted for adaptive search. Timed trial field statistically_confirmed meant only interval exclusion; final code sets statistically_confirmed=false and reports development_interval_excludes_zero separately.
